decisions.decision: Minutes of the March 9, 2017 meeting were accepted (no motion recorded).
decisions.quote: minutes of the march 9, 2017, meeting were accepted.

decisions.decision: SWTF Education Subcommittee (Jack Rabbitt and Phyllis Luck) to begin work on the items due in 2017 under MCM draft 1.
decisions.quote: it was determined that the swtf education subcommittee, jack rabbitt and phyllis luck, will begin to work on items to be completed in 2017

decisions.decision: The Assessor's Office is the Responsible Entity for providing Guidance for Industrial Stormwater Management for Industrial Facilities.
decisions.quote: it was further determined that the responsible entity for providing guidance for industrial stormwater management for industrial facilities would be the assessor's office.

decisions.decision: Continue recruiting one additional task force member, as the task force has 4 of 5 members.
decisions.quote: the group will continue to reach out to enlist one additional member, as the task force currently has 4 members.

decisions.decision: A Stormwater Management Plan manager will not be pursued at this time, though the need is recognized.
decisions.quote: it was determined that this would not be pursued at this time, although the need is recognized.

decisions.decision: Messages will originate in the SWTF, with distribution Responsible Entities spread among Town Boards and Institutions.
decisions.quote: it was affirmed that the messages to be sent will originate in the swtf, although responsible entities for distribution will be spread among town boards and institutions.

decisions.decision: Community rain garden considered worthy of inclusion in the NOI, though not an MCM requirement.
decisions.quote: creation of a community rain garden, which is not a requirement of this mcm, was considered worthy of inclusion

decisions.decision: DCI to forward the altered Measurable goals as soon as possible.
decisions.quote: some measurable goals were altered; dci will forward the changes asap.

decisions.decision: Storm Drain Stenciling and Community Cleanups will not be part of the NOI submittal.
decisions.quote: storm drain stenciling and community cleanups are not requirements of the new ms4 permit, and will not be a part of the noi submittal.

decisions.decision: Construction-site regulations to be written by a working group of Planning Board and Conservation Commission members as one set used by all boards, in place by June 2018; current bylaws then moved to General Bylaws.
decisions.quote: created by a working group composed of planning board and conservation commission members; that there will be one set of regulations which all boards will utilize and enforce

decisions.decision: How the Town ensures boards and personnel follow the new BMPs, and who signs the NOI, to be discussed with the Board of Selectmen.
decisions.quote: both these items will be discussed with the board of selectmen.

decisions.decision: IDDE and Good House Keeping/Pollution Prevention to be discussed at the next DCI meeting on May 25.
decisions.quote: it was determined that at our next meeting with dci, on may 25,

decisions.decision: Remaining agenda items deferred to the next meeting, 4/27/17, because the hour was late.
decisions.quote: as the hour was late, other items on the agenda were deferred to the next meeting, to be held on 4/27/17.

decisions.decision: Meeting schedule set: April 27, May 11, May 25 (6 pm start), June 8 and 22; July 27, August 24, September 14 and 28 in the 3rd quarter, at the Ritter building at 6:30 pm unless noted.
decisions.quote: the schedule of meetings will be april 27, may 11, may 25 (6 pm start), june 8 and 22.
